subject: Data retention exception follow-up / FinSecure - next steps
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finsecure.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Data retention exception follow-up / FinSecure - next steps

Hi Elena

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

Summary of FinSecure requirement:
- Zero retention of any PII (no searchable or reversible logs containing customer PII).
- Short-term retention for non-PII operational logs (7 days) for debugging and fraud detection.

What Redwood can offer today:
- Hosted API (default): request/response metadata retained for 30 days for monitoring and abuse prevention. PII redaction is available at the prompt layer, but we cannot guarantee 0 retention for Hosted customers without additional controls.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): supports custom retention policies and configurable log redaction. We can route logs to a short-lived store and remove them on your schedule.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full control over logs and retention; this supports 0-retention for PII as part of the deployment and is the strongest option for your requirement.

Proposed path forward:
1) Confirm whether FinSecure needs contractual 0-retention for all PII (including derived metadata) or operational controls that achieve equivalent risk reduction (e.g., immediate masking + 7-day indexed logs for non-PII).
2) If you need contractual 0-retention, we should scope Dedicated vs Private. I can loop in Solutions Eng to provide an implementation estimate and dataflow diagram.
3) We can start a retention-exception addendum to the DPA. I attached a DPA draft and our security overview for reference.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-security-overview.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: DPA_draft.docx (DOCX)]

Next steps / asks for FinSecure:
- Please confirm the exact retention SLA requirement (e.g., 0 seconds for PII, 7 days for non-PII logs).
- Please share any internal data-flow diagram or classification rules you use for PII so we can validate redaction coverage.

I'll loop Camila (sec solutions) on technical feasibility and Marissa (sales ops/legal) for contract work. Happy to get a technical deep-dive on Monday if helpful.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-security-overview.pdf]

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finsecure.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@finsecure.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data retention exception follow-up / FinSecure - next steps

Thanks Rafael

Quick answers from our side:
- FinSecure requires contractual 0-retention for any PII that can be tied back to a natural person. That includes name, email, SSN, account identifiers, and any direct or indirect identifiers per our data classification doc.
- Non-PII operational logs (stack traces, latency metrics, anonymized counters) we can accept 7 days retention.

Legal requests:
- Please provide a written statement on exactly where logs are retained today for Hosted/Dedicated options and how Redwood implements redaction.
- We also want to circulate the DPA draft for redlines to legal.

Tom Becker from our security team will be on the thread from now on for technical Qs: tom.becker@finsecure.com

Thanks
Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Product Security | FinSecure

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finsecure.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@finsecure.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data retention exception follow-up / FinSecure - next steps

Hi Elena / Tom

Thanks for the clarity. I wanted to outline the technical options and what we'd need to deliver a contractual 0-retention posture for PII.

Options summary:
1) Private (VPC / on-prem):
   - Most straightforward for 0-retention. Customer controls the ingestion and storage; we can configure the runtime to not persist any raw request/response content.
   - Redwood provides the control plane; you host inference nodes.
   - ETA for PoC: ~4-6 weeks (infra + security review).

2) Dedicated with custom retention & redaction:
   - We can implement an engineering change to enforce immediate redaction of configured PII fields and purge any transient logs on a short schedule.
   - For contractual 0-retention we typically require a technical attestation and an SOW for the engineering work.
   - JIRA ticket created to track scope: SEC-578.

Technical requirements / asks from FinSecure:
- Provide a representative set of sample requests (sanitized) and your PII detection rules (regex/policy) so we can validate redaction coverage.
- Dataflow diagram showing where logs traverse (client -> edge -> runtime -> storage).

Controls we can provide immediately:
- Request-level redaction hooks (masking), token-level tracing disabled for the route, and dedicated audit trail that excludes PII fields.
- Access controls, KMS-backed key management, and enhanced logging only to Security-approved S3 buckets with scheduled lifecycle rules.

I attached a simple dataflow diagram to show points where we can intercept and redact PII. Also happy to run a short demo of our redaction pipeline with example inputs.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-dataflow.png (PNG)]

Camila Reyes
Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finsecure.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@finsecure.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data retention exception follow-up / FinSecure - next steps

Appreciate the fast responses — summary and next steps we agreed internally and with FinSecure:

Agreed approach:
- FinSecure requirement: contractual 0-retention for PII, 7-day retention for non-PII operational logs.
- Preferred Redwood option: evaluate Dedicated with a retention addendum. If Dedicated cannot meet the attestation requirements we will move to a Private deployment.

Action items (owners & timeline):
1) FinSecure (Elena / Tom): provide sample requests and dataflow diagram due EOD 2027-08-20.
2) Redwood (Camila): produce a technical feasibility note + estimated implementation plan and ETA (JIRA SEC-578) due 2027-08-19.
3) Redwood (Marissa): prepare DPA addendum and SOW template for a retention exception; circulate to FinSecure legal for redline, initial draft by 2027-08-19.
4) Both: schedule a 60-min technical sync w/ security + infra (propose 2027-08-23).

I'll kick off the internal SOW and share the DocuSign link once the draft is ready. If we get the sample data this week we can validate redaction on our side and hopefully reach an agreement without requiring Private deployment.

Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the Docusign link and the SOW draft.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
[Attachment: DPA_draft.docx]
